Activate 2 (manipulate)

A blue mist swirls inside this small glass vial. While you are holding your breath, you can uncork the vial and inhale the mist, expanding your lung capacity and increasing the time you can hold your breath by 5 rounds. You don't lose any additional air when you breathe it in.

In addition, the mist fills your nose with an ozone scent, masking other odors. For the next 5 rounds or until you stop holding your breath, you gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against olfactory effects, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Stench].
